notes.title: DOT & DOT DUNGEONS available now!
notes.content:
DOT & DOT DUNGEONS has finally been released!
The pixel art × roguelike game is now available for $4.99.
[b]*10% off for the first week after launch*[/b]
A demo version is available, so anyone interested can give it a go!
[url=https://t.co/Rx82oAhhb9]https://t.co/Rx82oAhhb9[/url]

notes.title: Notice of Determination of Release Date
notes.content:
DOT & DOT DUNGEONS will be released on [h1][b]October 25, 2024[/b][/h1]
The following elements will be added from the demo version

[b][list]
[*] Dungeons
[*] Professions
[*] Skills
[*] Types of equipment
[*] Effects on equipment
[*] Gimmicks in the dungeon
[/list][/b]

If you haven't played the demo version yet, please do so!
If you like it, don't forget to add it to your wish list!

notes.title: Announcement of Going Gold
notes.content:
DOT & DOT DUNGEONS has finally gone gold. The release date is still being adjusted and will be announced later. We have released a demo version, so if you haven’t played it yet, why not take this opportunity to give it a try?
If you like it, please consider adding it to your wishlist.

notes.title: Trial version is now available!
notes.content:
A demo version of the game is now available to play the early stages of the game!　If you have even the slightest interest in DOT & DOT DUNGEONS, we encourage you to play it!

▼ Notes.
*You can play two dungeons.
*Character level is limited to 20.
*The game is still under development, so there may be some differences from the production version. Unexpected bugs may occur.
*Transferring saved data from the demo version to the full version is not supported.
